name: solio-mobile
description: Solio student marketplace Capacitor Android and iOS app

scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
